text: The fuel tank holds 17.0 litres. The manual gives the low fuel warning as 3 litres, plus or minus 0.5 litre, so roughly 3 litres is left in the tank when it comes on. Watch out: Do not overfill: fill only to the bottom of the anti splash plate. Overfilling may let gasoline enter the EVAP canister and damage the evaporative emission system. Watch out: If the last bar of the fuel level indicator blinks continuously, the tank is low; re-fuel immediately. The manual does not say how many litres the fill level at the anti splash plate holds.
